The search index is unavailable, so I’m querying Crossref for the exact paper title to identify its publication record and any accessible link.
```python
crossref_lookup = await web_fetch("https://api.crossref.org/works?query.title=Can%20Hiccup%20Supply%20Enough%20Fish%20to%20Maintain%20a%20Dragon%27s%20Diet&rows=5", max_chars=12000)
print(crossref_lookup)
```
I’m checking the University of Leicester journal archive directly for the title, since these student papers are often hosted outside general search indexes.
```python
archive_lookup = await web_fetch("https://www.google.com/search?q=%22Can+Hiccup+Supply+Enough+Fish+to+Maintain+a+Dragon%27s+Diet%22", max_chars=12000)
print(archive_lookup)
```
I’m also querying an alternate scholarly index for the exact title and abstract text, which may expose the numerical calculation even if the PDF is not indexed.
```python
scholar_lookup = await web_fetch("https://api.openalex.org/works?search=Can%20Hiccup%20Supply%20Enough%20Fish%20to%20Maintain%20a%20Dragon%27s%20Diet&per-page=5", max_chars=12000)
print(scholar_lookup)
```
The scholarly endpoints may not expose this student paper; I’m using the University of Leicester’s likely Journal of Physics Special Topics archive search endpoint next.
```python
leicester_archive = await web_fetch("https://www.google.com/search?q=site%3Aphysics.le.ac.uk+%22Hiccup%22+fish+dragon", max_chars=12000)
print(leicester_archive)
```
